description: Source code for extracting and processing Certificate Transparency (CT) related objects, including SCT lists from certificates and OCSP responses, with functions for parsing ASN.1 structures and handling SCT extensions.

methods.name: ExtractEmbeddedSCTList
methods.description: Extracts the SCT list embedded in a certificate's extensions.

methods.name: GetPrecertSignedEntry
methods.description: Generates a SignedEntryData for a precertificate, including the modified TBSCertificate without SCT extension.

methods.name: GetX509SignedEntry
methods.description: Creates a SignedEntryData for a standard X.509 certificate.

methods.name: ExtractSCTListFromOCSPResponse
methods.description: Extracts SCT list from an OCSP response matching a specific issuer and serial number.
